# Tool classes

- Every tool extends `AbstractAgentTool`. Its `handle()` runs `authorize()` first, then (for a sectioned tool) `requestedSection()`, then `audit()` with the shape and resolved section (never values) before any data is read, then the read-only work, then `redactor()` on the output last.
- `authorize()` reads `config('agent-mcp.tools.<name>')`, which is false when unset. The tool name (`#[Name]` or `protected string $name`, both are in use) must equal that config key.
- A new tool is registered in `AgentMcpServer::$tools` and its flag is added to `config/agent-mcp.php`. A tool that is off by default also joins `AbstractMcpCliCommand::SENSITIVE_TOOLS` (the CLI `--allow-tty` guard) and the off-by-default lists in the server `#[Instructions]` and `InstallCommand`; keep those lists in step by hand (only the `SENSITIVE_TOOLS` dataset in `AbstractMcpCliCommandTest` is pinned).
- Each tool has one `tests/Feature/Tools/<Tool>Test.php`, written in Pest `it()` style.
